components.css: .ds-subject-card{min-width:0;min-height:15.5rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);background:var(--surface-primary);padding:1.05rem;text-decoration:none;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);transition:transform var(--motion-standard) ease,box-shadow var(--motion-standard) ease}.ds-subject-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-md)}.ds-subject-card:focus-visible{outline:auto;outline-offset:2px}.ds-subject-code{width:2.6rem;height:2.6rem;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--brand-primary) 11%,white);color:var(--brand-primary);font-size:.68rem;font-weight:850}.ds-subject-body{margin-top:1rem}.ds-subject-body h3{margin:0;font-size:.98rem;line-height:1.3}.ds-subject-body p{margin:.35rem 0 0;color:var(--text-secondary);font-size:.67rem;line-height:1.4}.ds-subject-route{min-height:2.5rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:.65rem;margin-top:auto;border-top:1px solid var(--border-default);padding-top:.75rem;color:var(--text-secondary);font-size:.65rem}.ds-subject-route strong{color:var(--brand-primary);font-weight:750}

narrative.overview: A warm, professional learning workspace whose hierarchy always points to the next meaningful step. Institutional structure remains calm while tactile route markers and restrained educational accents make progress visible.
keyCharacteristics: Work-first hierarchy with the next action visible early.
Warm paper surfaces and disciplined institutional color.
Semantic tenant theming without component forks.
Responsive learning and review workflows with 44px targets.

rules.name: Yellow Carries Meaning
rules.body: Yellow is reserved for attention and forward action and never carries white text.

rules.name: Semantic Tenant
rules.body: Change tenant identity through semantic tokens, never component forks.

rules.name: Next Step First
rules.body: Place the meaningful learning or review action in the first viewport.

rules.name: Ambient First
rules.body: Stronger lift appears only for hierarchy, overlay, or interaction.

dos: Do place the next meaningful learning or review action before broad summaries.
Do preserve visible labels, non-color status cues, strong focus rings, and 44px targets.
Do use the same semantic component structure for every tenant.
donts: Don't turn the workspace into a dense ERP dashboard, generic LMS grid, marketing page, or glassmorphic control center.
Don't use white text on yellow or use yellow as a general decorative fill.
Don't invent a Colegio Conquistadores crest.
